overview_description.description: Auterion is the leading autonomy software company building swarms, not drones. Its operating system, AuterionOS, transforms individual unmanned systems into coordinated swarms across air, land, and sea. Auterion technology has been battle-proven in Ukraine, powering one of the largest autonomous deployments in modern warfare, and Auterion is applying the lessons learned there globally, including helping Taiwan develop its swarming capabilities Headquartered in Arlington, VA and with offices in Munich, Germany and hubs across Europe, Auterion partners with the US and its allies, major defense primes, and startups, to deliver autonomous mass with AI-enabled swarms that resist jamming, overwhelm defenses, and secure mission success. By uniting global manufacturers under one interoperable platform, Auterion is defining the next era of warfare: software-first, scalable, and built to defend the freedoms we enjoy.

about_short_description.short_description: Auterion provides a platform that unifies a diverse fleet of autonomous robots, catering to a wide range of applications and use cases.

product.name: AuterionOS
product.description: An onboard operating system for autonomous drones and robots that connects vehicles, applications, and fleet operations through an open, vendor-independent architecture.

product.name: Auterion Suite
product.description: A cloud-based fleet management and data operations platform for monitoring vehicles, synchronizing missions, reviewing flight data, deploying software, and managing maintenance activities.

product.name: Skynode X
product.description: An integrated flight computer and autopilot system that provides onboard computing, vehicle control, mission execution, video processing, and connectivity for autonomous aircraft.

product.name: Auterion Mission Control
product.description: A ground-control application for planning, executing, and monitoring missions across drones and other autonomous vehicles from a unified interface.

product.name: Auterion Nemyx
product.description: A cross-platform autonomy and swarm-coordination software system that enables compatible drones to operate as a coordinated group and execute multi-vehicle missions.

product.name: Long Range
product.description: A long-range autonomous strike capability combining unmanned aircraft hardware with Auterion’s autonomy, navigation, and mission software for operations at distances of up to 1,000 miles.
